purpose: Teach: 船橋/府中/松村/岡部/江田/栗原/角田/板橋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、船橋キャンパスの研究員と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren, coordinate with the research staff at Funabashi campus.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Brief pause before the name to ensure attention. Clipped authority without harshness. Eyes steady, shoulders back.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。府中の研究所の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through the papers from the Fuchu research institute.
lines.style: Immediate, respectful affirmation. Slight lean forward to show attentiveness. Quiet determination underneath — he's already mentally organizing his reading list.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の松村先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren, contact Professor Matsumura about the joint research inquiry.
lines.style: Same clipped authority as before. This is the third directive in sequence — tone stays steady, efficient. No softening, but not impatient either.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で岡部助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to listen to Assistant Professor Okabe's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Slight eagerness underneath the formal surface. A half-nod of confirmation. He's already thought ahead about this — his voice carries the quiet satisfaction of someone connecting the pieces.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の江田先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren, reference Professor Eda's papers from the literature as well.
lines.style: Another instruction, same register. Businesslike delivery. The word 'also' lands lightly — he's building a comprehensive picture, and Ren understands that.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の栗原先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll seek guidance from Kurihara-senpai in the lab.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with a layer of humility — acknowledging the seniority. Slightly slower than the previous 'yes,' showing he's genuinely noting this as a separate action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の角田教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren, set up a meeting with Professor Tsuno about the overseas collaboration.
lines.style: Final directive in the sequence. Tone remains composed but carries slight finality — this is the last one, and Hiroshi knows it matters. Level delivery, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、板橋事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application to the administrative office — Itabashi — for research funding.
lines.style: Final affirmation. A touch more detail this time, showing he's understood the full chain of action. Quiet resolve. His voice settles slightly, acknowledging the end of instructions.
